Three buyers interested in your home. What happens next?

In Scotland, when more than one buyer notes interest through their solicitor, I can set a closing date. Every buyer submits their best offer by a fixed day and time, and you choose.

Price is only part of it. I look at each buyer's position, their finance and their date of entry, and talk you through which offer is strongest, not just highest.

If you want to know whether your home would draw that kind of interest, I will give you a realistic figure first.

Book a free valuation at duncanure.co.uk/valuation?utm_source=facebook

Your Home Report value and your offers over price are two different numbers.

The Home Report value is the surveyor's opinion, and it is the figure most buyers' lenders work from. The offers over price is the number buyers search on.

Set the offers over price slightly under the Home Report value and you widen the pool of buyers who see your home and can borrow against it. Set it above and you narrow it.

I price every home against the Home Report and the recent sales around it, then we agree the number together.

Book a free valuation at duncanure.co.uk/valuation?utm_source=facebook
